title: Phisguard EIP7702
tagline: 🛡️AI-powered blockchain security protocol using Eigen Layer AVS to intercept and validate transactions in real-time. Implements EIP7702 for enhanced EOA account protection, leveraging advanced autonomus AI to detect and prevent potential phising with instant risk assessment.
description:
PhisGuard revolutionizes blockchain wallet security by empowering verifiable AI and Externally Owned Accounts (EOAs) with the EIP-7702 standard. This innovation transforms EOAs into more secure wallets, enhancing security without compromising the user experience.

By integrating verifiable AI and Eigen Layer Actively Validated Services (AVS), PhisGuard fortifies EOA transactions against evolving threats, including phishing attacks. The platform provides a decentralized, multi-layered security framework that validates transactions dynamically while preserving blockchain transparency and efficiency. Every transaction is validated by verifiable AI secured by crypto economicsecurity by Eigen Layer.

With PhisGuard, EOA wallets gain more security while maintaining their native flexibility, making them more resilient against phising and any threats. This approach ensures users can transact with confidence, leveraging next-generation security without sacrificing decentralization or usability.
how_its_made: This project uses @0xautonome to create an AI Agent for detecting whether a transaction is potentially phishing or not. The project also implements EIP7702 to inject SmartAccount code into an EOA Wallet. Every transaction will be intercepted and then transformed into an EIP7702-compatible format and execute the function injected into the EOA Wallet. The function will create a task and trigger an AVS Operator to execute a task containing transaction data that will be analyzed by AI. The Operator will submit a task assessment with analysis results to the Service Manager Contract. The Service Manager contract will then check if the transaction is safe to execute.
